description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the JobTitleDao class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It contains multiple test methods that verify the correct behavior of data access methods for job titles, including retrieval, filtering, deletion, and related entity access.

classes.name: JobTitleDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of the JobTitleDao class, including methods for retrieving, filtering, and deleting job titles, as well as fetching related entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the JobTitleDao instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all job titles, asserting the count and specific job titles returned.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of job titles assigned to specific employees, verifying counts and names.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleListWithInactiveJobTitles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of job titles including inactive ones, verifying total count.

methods.name: testDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified job titles and checks the number of deletions.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleById
methods.description: Tests fetching a job title by ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Tests fetching a job specification attachment by ID.

methods.name: testGetJobTitles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of job titles with filtering options, verifying counts and names.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Tests counting of job titles with filters applied.
